notes: Karty (Cards) jsou seskupené kolem 'Masters' (postav vůdců) a frakcí/tematických skupin. Statistiky jsou level-1 hodnoty z wiki; u řady karet nebyly cost/attack/health veřejně dohledány a jsou null.

factions.name: Empyrean
factions.description: Defensive faction emphasizing buildings, holy warriors and healing; built around a Divine Shield-style mechanic.

factions.name: Voidborne
factions.description: Brutal demonic invaders from another realm; aggressive, high-damage units built around a Void Rift mechanic.

factions.name: Zen-Chi
factions.description: Electricity-themed faction focused on stunning enemies and healing allies.

factions.name: Scrat
factions.description: Low-health, inexpensive swarm units used for cycling and chip damage.

factions.name: Accursed
factions.description: Undead-themed faction; slower decks built around the Spectral Essence mechanic and spirit/health bonuses.

factions.name: Slither
factions.description: Snake-themed faction ruled by the god Apep; features sacrifice mechanics and high-aggression cards.

factions.name: Puff
factions.description: Small faction, mostly defensive/utility, centered on granting shields and buffs; associated with King Puff.

factions.name: Stoutheart
factions.description: Newer faction centered on the Revelry mechanic and Runewyrd runic magic (elemental/necromantic rune stones).

factions.name: Outlander
factions.description: Sci-fi/robot-themed faction featuring turrets, drones and laser/plasma weaponry.

factions.name: Crystal Elf
factions.description: Magic/crystal-themed faction featuring arcane golems and crystal spellcasters.

cards.name: Valorian
abilities: Heirloom Blade basic attack: 40 damage, 2s cooldown, range 10, +5 damage per Empyrean card in hand
Perk - Searing Light: adds a 1-mana one-use spell card to top of deck every 30s (Valorian dives off the tower to strike enemies)
Perk - Holy Light: heals up to 5 injured friendly minions for 20 health
cards.description: The starter Master, devoted to the light; heals allies and invokes righteous fury on enemies.

cards.name: Apep
abilities: Basic attack: spits acid at up to 2 enemies for 25 damage every 2.5s
Perk: every 35s adds a random 2-mana Minion/Building card to top of deck with cost reduced by 2
Shield Totem: while alive, redirects all non-true damage Apep would take to the totem
cards.description: The Serpent God and supreme ruler of the Slither faction; arrogant ancient deity that controls minions like Slitherbound.

cards.name: Diona
abilities: Trap-based playstyle
Crossbow basic attack
Pet dog companion 'Ruffles' with semi-random behavior
cards.description: Diona the Witch Hunter; specializes in tactical traps and crossbow combat, accompanied by her dog Ruffles.

cards.name: Mordar
abilities: Soul orb basic attack
Tombstone: acts as a respawn point for his minions
Perks grant revival and haste effects
cards.description: The Mad Lich; focused on dark resurrection mechanics using soul orbs and tombstones.

cards.name: Stormbringer
abilities: Longest basic attack range of any Master
Perks: Long Shot, Aerodynamics (+range), Lightning Reflexes (faster shooting)
cards.description: The Far-Shot Master; a default/early master emphasizing precision, long-range passive ranged attacks and suppression.

cards.name: Ratbo
abilities: Pilots a rapid-fire mechanical contraption
Perk: continuous scrat generation
Perk - 'More Dakka': chaingun attack
cards.description: The Scrat King; emphasizes overwhelming swarm tactics.

cards.name: Volco
abilities: Burn the Bridges: deals damage on bridges
Tempers Flaring: rage buff
Tempers Burning: berserker rage buff
cards.description: Aggressive, melee-focused Master built around rage/aggro playstyles.

cards.name: Ravager
abilities: Summons 'Brutus' tank minion
Feeding Frenzy buff
cards.description: Defense-oriented Master, strong against low-range units.

cards.name: King Puff
abilities: Perk - 'King Buff': grants shields or rage to 4-5 mana cards
cards.description: Buff-focused Master associated with the Puff faction; considered a high-skill-ceiling Master.

cards.name: Settsu
abilities: Jump/mobility ability
Magazine-based firing system (reload mechanic)
cards.description: Mobile, aggressive attacker Master.

cards.name: Milloween
abilities: Companion Arcane Golem ('turtle') that scales with spells cast
cards.description: Spell-focused Master; strong when paired with Accursed synergies per community discussion.

cards.name: Morellia
abilities: Book of the Dead mechanic
Late-game dragon summon
cards.description: Versatile Master with a late-game dragon summon via the Book of the Dead.

cards.name: R3KT
cards.description: One of the 14 playable Masters; limited public detail found.

cards.name: Tronveir
abilities: Runewyrd: runic magic exclusive to Stoutheart, imbuing stones with Elemental Powers or Necromancy
cards.description: Master of Runewyrd, wielding runic magic unique to the Stoutheart faction.

cards.name: Colossus
abilities: Sweeping area-of-effect attack hitting ground units in a 180° arc
cards.description: A massive 9-mana Empyrean minion with a sweeping area-of-effect attack; damage was buffed from 250 to 275 in a past update.

cards.name: Spear Throwers
abilities: First attack after summon is a ranged spear throw (range 9)
cards.description: Empyrean minion whose opening attack is a thrown spear before switching to melee.

cards.name: Shieldguard of Light
abilities: Armor of Light: deals 75 damage back when hit
Shield Slam: 70 damage attack
cards.description: Heavily armored Empyrean minion; rarity was changed from Supreme to Rare in Update 2.0.

cards.name: Succubus
abilities: Netherstep: teleports toward the friendly Master Tower when enemies close in (distance 8, 1s cooldown)
cards.description: Ranged Voidborne unit that teleports away when enemies get too close.

cards.name: Rammer
cards.description: Aggressive, high-damage Voidborne unit associated with the Void Rift mechanic.

cards.name: Scrat Pack
abilities: Scrat Swarm: gains Haste
cards.description: Cheap 1-mana Scrat card used for cycling and distracting single-target attackers.

cards.name: Skeleton Crew
abilities: Generates/relates to Spectral Essence
cards.description: Accursed minion tied to the Spectral Essence mechanic, which powers up cards like Ghost Turret and Nyrvir the Fallen.

cards.name: Undead Army
abilities: Spectral Essence mechanic
cards.description: Accursed minion card involved in the Spectral Essence build-up mechanic.

cards.name: Ghost Turret
abilities: Grows stronger as Spectral Essence is gathered
cards.description: Accursed building card powered up by Spectral Essence.

cards.name: Nyrvir the Fallen
abilities: Summoned after gathering enough Spectral Essence
cards.description: Legendary Accursed dragon summoned once enough Spectral Essence has been collected.

cards.name: Bahra the Witchwolf
abilities: On-summon: roots enemies starting from its spawn point, slowly affecting further enemies
cards.description: Legendary Accursed minion (also referred to informally as 'Bahra the Necromancer' in some sources) that roots nearby enemies on summon.

cards.name: Living Statue
abilities: Targets enemy Buildings
cards.description: High-health statue/golem card that targets buildings; sources conflicted on its faction (Accursed vs. Slither), so faction is left unset.

cards.name: Blue Golem
cards.description: High-health tank that provides a sturdy frontline for Zen-Chi decks.

cards.name: Zen-chi Seven-Year Spirit
cards.description: Zen-Chi faction minion (limited detail found).

cards.name: Xiao Long
cards.description: Zen-Chi faction minion (limited detail found).

cards.name: Healing Fireball
abilities: Heals friendly units (fireball-themed spell)
cards.description: Zen-Chi spell card.

cards.name: Annihilator
cards.description: Outlander faction minion (limited detail found).

cards.name: S.T.INT
cards.description: Outlander robot-themed minion.

cards.name: Laser Turret
cards.description: Outlander turret building; long-controversial for its power level, prompted multiple nerf discussions; rarity changed from Common to Rare in Update 2.0.

cards.name: Troubleshooter
abilities: Remains stealthed while stationary
cards.description: Outlander stealth unit that stays hidden as long as it doesn't move.

cards.name: Drone Force
cards.description: Outlander drone-themed minion card.

cards.name: Beam of DOOM!
cards.description: Outlander spell card, referenced in balance discussions.

cards.name: Crystal Arcanist
abilities: Ranged attacker
cards.description: Crystal Elf ranged minion; rarity changed from Rare to Common in Update 2.0.

cards.name: Crystal Sentry
cards.description: Crystal Elf faction minion (limited detail found).

cards.name: Arcane Golem
cards.description: Crystal Elf golem minion; associated with Master Milloween as a scaling companion.

cards.name: Slitherbound
cards.description: Slither faction unit controlled by Apep.

cards.name: Musketeer
abilities: Applies Poison, dealing damage over time
cards.description: Slither/gunner-themed minion that poisons its target.

cards.name: Harbinger
abilities: Attack speed 5, range 14
Knockback: if its attack hits a minion that survives, that minion is knocked back 6 range
cards.description: High-rarity Slither-grouped minion with strong ranged damage and knockback.

cards.name: Bridge Shrine
abilities: Generates XP and converts it to mana
cards.description: Slither building card that generates XP, converted into mana.

cards.name: Plasma Marines
cards.description: Common 3-mana minion card with modest stats.

cards.name: Mana Puff
cards.description: Puff faction minion (limited detail found).
